$comment: Copy to config.json in this directory (git-ignored) or to ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-~/.config}/prflow/config.json. Each account needs a gh login: gh auth login, then check with gh auth status. prflow reads tokens with gh auth token -u <login> and never switches the active account.

accounts.$comment: Work account: every repo under these owners, plus one repo elsewhere. A repos entry wins over another account's owners entry.
Personal account: no owners or repos means every repo not claimed above. At most one account may be unscoped.
